contexts.text: Like a house founded upon ice, which falls to the bottom when the ice melts.
Like the thin plates... called Mary's ice (mica).
All the water appeared bound with ice.
Like those who are carried in a chariot over thin ice.
The vernal light... melts the ice.
I compared them to fishes under the ice.
They become as cold as snow and ice. (See Cold.)
I was in places where I saw nothing but ice outside the houses.
They who seduce by the appearance of piety... when they approach Heaven, become cold like ice, whereby they are miserably tormented.
